description: A transposition table remembers what a search learned about a position: its score, whether the score is exact or a bound, and the best move. When another move order reaches the same position, the search answers from the table instead of searching again. An entry answers only at the same remaining depth, or at any depth from its *reach* on if its search was proven. An exact entry always answers, a bound only when it lies outside the window; the stored best move is tried first otherwise. `SlotTable` has a fixed number of slots and replaces on every store; `MapTable` (feature `hashbrown`) holds entries in a hash map up to a size cap.
